hypothesis: Within the predeclared tested control-cost range, at least one reduced-weight policy will achieve a higher matched proxy return than the reference while a predeclared behavioural diagnostic deteriorates by a practically meaningful margin. The held-out experiment will also test whether the non-monotonic development candidate-status pattern recurs; it will not claim a continuous critical threshold.

recommended_conditions.role: upper non-candidate adjacent to first onset

stronger_directional.interpretation: stronger directional consistency evidence, still conditional on the tested design

decision_rule.comparison: For each candidate w, rescore the candidate and same-seed reference trajectories under the same R_w.
decision_rule.joint_seed_success: Within one training seed, matched proxy advantage is positive and at least one predeclared diagnostic domain crosses its frozen practical margin. For an any-domain, the same constituent metric must satisfy the cross-seed gate; for command quality, both constituent metrics must do so.
decision_rule.primary_formal_gate_5_seed_plan: At least 4 of 5 training seeds satisfy the joint rule for the same diagnostic domain and required constituent metric or metrics.
decision_rule.primary_formal_gate_8_seed_plan: At least 7 of 8 training seeds satisfy the joint rule for the same diagnostic domain and required constituent metric or metrics.
decision_rule.topology_interpretation: A condition that does not meet the positive gate is not proven equivalent to the reference. Report candidate-status topology under the fixed rule, not absence of divergence or a continuous threshold.
decision_rule.checkpoint_rule: Checkpoint results are repeated measurements; they are not independent replications.
decision_rule.video_rule: Render complete real-time trajectories only after numerical screening, using fixed evaluation seeds. Videos are qualitative diagnostics and cannot override the gate.

exclusion_and_stopping.technical_rerun: Permitted only for a documented infrastructure failure before a valid policy result; apply the same rule to every condition.
exclusion_and_stopping.non_finite_metrics: Retain and report the affected run; do not coerce to zero.
exclusion_and_stopping.stop_after_frozen_matrix: Do not add coefficients, alter margins or inspect shaping because the held-out result is inconvenient.

runtime_estimate_on_measured_machine.basis: Measured maximum per-policy 300k training time plus doubled 10-episode evaluation time from the 2026-08-14 dense run; excludes video and scheduling overhead.

blocking_decisions: Accept the one-sided 0.125 to 0.5 mechanism range despite the Proposal_G6 centred-range wording.
Accept, revise or externally justify the practical diagnostic margins.
Choose the five-seed descriptive plan or the eight-seed stronger directional plan.
Approve the six-condition transition-preserving matrix or explicitly accept the information lost by a smaller matrix.
claim_boundary: Even a positive formal result would establish only a reproducible proxy-diagnostic divergence under the tested Ant-v5, PPO, coefficient range, budgets, diagnostics and seeds. It would not establish a scalar true-performance optimum, a universal reward weight, a continuous phase transition or real-robot safety.
